rain: The reference image is the character's model sheet. Draw EXACTLY this character: the same terracotta pot body with the same colour, the same bright green seedling, leaf-arms and feet, the same face style, the same proportions. Draw it at EXACTLY the same size and placement as the reference: centred, the tips of the seedling leaves near the top edge of the frame and the feet on the bottom edge. Do NOT shrink the character to make room for anything. POSE: happy in a light rain. The eyes are the same large glossy near-black ovals with one white highlight dot each as the reference, looking at the viewer. A happy smile. A small opaque glossy blue-grey cartoon cloud floats in the upper-right corner beside the seedling leaves, with four or five small opaque blue raindrops falling from it; a few blue raindrops are beaded on the pot. The pot is exactly as wide and as tall as in the reference, and the seedling exactly as big with its leaves just as wide; the character fills the frame top to bottom exactly like the reference. The cloud is small and tucked into the empty corner. Preserve the art style exactly: a smooth glossy 3D cartoon render like a shiny toy, clean simple surfaces with soft studio highlights. NO photographic texture, NO leaf veins, NO clay grain, NO realistic eyes. Cheeks stay flat soft pink circles. Compose the whole character and any prop fully inside the frame. The background must be a single flat uniform pure magenta (hex #FF00FF) filling every pixel that is not the character or its prop. No shadow, no reflection, no gradient, no vignette, no checkerboard, no ground, no text.
